ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with approximately 45% high-intensity white pixels and 55% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe displays a contiguous high-intensity white region with black mottling at the medial and anterior margins. Right lobe is predominantly low-intensity black with a non-contiguous high-intensity white patch on the lateral half containing dark linear streaks and scattered black mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) serrations along the trailing edge of the left lobe; right lobe trailing edge exhibits irregular, high-amplitude (15-20 pixel) jagged deviations at the lateral terminus.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a smooth convex sweep to the tip; right lobe exhibits a truncated convex trajectory terminating in a blunted, irregular profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of textured, high-contrast circular pixel anomalies (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of three horizontal, low-intensity linear rake marks breaking the high-intensity white pigmentation on the lateral-ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant physical truncation and irregular structural degradation of the right fluke tip, associated with high-density epibiotic colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive dark chevron-shaped pixel cluster located within the lateral high-intensity white field of the right lobe.
